items.title: General Electric (GE) Names Claire McDonough As GE Vernova CFO
items.summary: General Electric (NYSE:GE) energy unit GE Vernova appoints Rivian CFO Claire McDonough as its new Chief Financial Officer. McDonough is set to leave electric vehicle maker Rivian to take up the CFO role at GE Vernova. The move marks a key leadership change for GE's recently separated energy focused business.
